description: This file defines the `SessionActions` enum containing static methods to manage and interact with session data, including patching, resetting, deleting, compacting sessions, confirming destructive actions via alerts, presenting errors, and opening session logs within a macOS application.

methods.name: patchSession
methods.description: Asynchronously sends a request to patch a session with optional thinking and verbose levels.

methods.name: resetSession
methods.description: Asynchronously resets a session identified by a key.

methods.name: deleteSession
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a session identified by a key and optionally deletes its transcript.

methods.name: compactSession
methods.description: Asynchronously compacts a session based on a maximum line count.

methods.name: confirmDestructiveAction
methods.description: Displays a confirmation dialog for destructive actions with a title, message, and action label.

methods.name: presentError
methods.description: Displays an error alert with a title and error details.

methods.name: openSessionLogInCode
methods.description: Attempts to locate and open a session log file in Visual Studio Code or Finder based on session ID and optional store path.
